name: heygen
description: Inspect the optional HeyGen API account, avatar LOOK IDs and voice IDs, or check/collect an existing video without submitting another generation. Actions account, list_avatars and list_voices are read-only. For status/collect use the exact provider_video_id and kind=model or avatar from the original receipt; collect only downloads/saves completed output and never creates a video. A Jarvis background job_id is a different identifier: after background admission wait for automatic delivery. This tool does not create/train avatars, clone voices, delete content, or generate Video Agent projects.

video_id.description: Existing exact HeyGen provider_video_id, required for status/collect. Not a Jarvis background job_id or a URL.

kind.description: Job kind from the receipt: model for general HeyGen Video clips, avatar for talking-avatar videos.

cursor.description: Exact next_cursor from a prior catalog page; omit for the first page.

availability.setup_hint: Set HEYGEN_API_KEY in the selected mode to enable optional HeyGen account/catalog/status tools.
